description:
Fetch subreddit metadata: subscriber count, description, rules, active users and appearance settings. Requires a Reddit session cookie in sessionCookies (obtain it from reddit-login.post, or copy reddit_session out of a signed-in browser) — Reddit has blocked every anonymous read surface since 2026-07-30.

upAPI operation `reddit-subreddit-info.get` (Social Media). Costs 4 units of monthly quota per call.

sessionCookies.description: REQUIRED IN PRACTICE. Reddit account session cookies, as a JSON object or a '; '-delimited cookie header; the blob must contain reddit_session. Since 2026-07-30 Reddit blocks EVERY anonymous read surface, so a call without cookies returns a classified UPSTREAM_BLOCKED rather than data. Obtain the blob from reddit-login.post, or copy the reddit_session cookie out of a signed-in browser. A lead-gen account-pool row stores it nested at cookies->>'sessionCookies', not at the row's top level.
sessionCookies.title: Sessioncookies

name: reddit_subreddit_info_get
title: Get Subreddit Info
